Exxonmobil Investment Management Has Lowered Citigroup Com New Com New (C) Stake by $1.81 Million; Share Price Declined; Maryland Capital Management Boosted Its Eaton Plc F (ETN) Position by $357,712; Stock Value Declined
May 31, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Exxonmobil Investment Management Inc decreased its stake in Citigroup Inc Com New Com New (C) by 6.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Exxonmobil Investment Management Inc sold 26,957 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 393,451 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $26.56 million, down from 420,408 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Exxonmobil Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc Com New Com New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $167.82B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.30% or $0.86 during the last trading session, reaching $65.82. About 2.82 million shares traded. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 10.48% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.09% the S&P500.
Maryland Capital Management increased its stake in Eaton Corp Plc F (ETN) by 24.22% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maryland Capital Management bought 4,528 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.87% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,226 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.86 million, up from 18,698 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maryland Capital Management who had been investing in Eaton Corp Plc F for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $33.78 billion market cap company.
